findings.description: The code constructs a shell command by concatenating user-supplied input (`url`) directly into the command string, then passes it to `std::system()`. This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary shell commands by crafting a malicious URL.
The code attempts to quote the URL, but this is not sufficient to prevent injection, especially if the URL contains quotes or shell metacharacters.
